g.text: Filled: stable across tested variants. Hollow: sensitive or insufficiently supported. ×: insufficient coverage. †: saturation.
Magnitudes of accepted assessment-block means; one wall selected using the other temporal half.
Regions do not identify material gas/liquid velocities. Stability does not establish experimental accuracy.
